# CrossSpeciesRSA

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Representational Similarity Analysis applied across species to compare neural activation patterns between human fMRI and macaque electrophysiology data. Enables validation of neuromorphic models against biological visual systems across species, informing biologically-plausible network architectures.
